summary.name: Psono fileserver
summary.one_liner: The GitLab repository for the Psono fileserver, a Python component of the Psono password manager for companies.
use_cases: self-host a password manager file server
check psono code ownership and branches
deploy shared file storage for a company password manager
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository for psono-fileserver, described as the Psono fileserver. It lists the Git revision selector with a master branch (marked default and protected), a develop branch (protected), and a scheduled-vulnerability-scan branch, plus 20 tags running from v7.0.11 to v7.0.30. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes Psono as a password manager for companies, with a demo and source code, licensed Apache-2.0 and written in Python. The page text itself contains no feature documentation, and the file listing did not load.
notable: Part of the Psono password manager for companies
Protected master and develop branches with version tags up to v7.0.30
caveats: Page text does not describe the fileserver's features or setup
